source_note: 参考2020年9月17日北侧正面实景。保留四檐三层、柱廊、高台与中轴阶梯，去除植被、游人、车辆及阶梯上的临时花卉装饰；图绘现存2002年重建楼体。摄影原图署名及许可保留，线稿为AI简化改绘。
prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: one fine-line illustration for the Chinese heritage atlas 访古. Image 1 is STYLE ONLY: the Vairocana drawing's extremely delicate, organic thin black contours, restrained internal detail and spacious white surfaces. Image 2 is the ACTUAL SUBJECT reference: Guanque Tower 鹳雀楼 at Yongji, Shanxi, the modern 2002 reconstruction photographed precisely from the north. Draw this exact tower's complete symmetrical facade including its tall terrace and central stone staircase, the four actual roof eave levels, three main visible storeys, progressively narrower upper volumes, horizontal galleries and the distinctive tall inward-facing chiwen at the ridge ends. Preserve the photographed silhouette, proportions, roof tiers, columns, galleries and terrace. Do not turn it into a generic pagoda, do not add extra levels. The lowest eave is the broad skirt above the first-floor veranda; the next eave is very close above it, the two upper eaves more widely spaced. Simplify carved wood and railings into a few sparse contour marks. Remove the temporary flower display on the stairs, draw plain stone steps instead. Remove tourists, vehicles, trees, lamps, flags, signs, plaque lettering, sky and paving beyond a couple of ground lines. Pure white background; extremely fine BLACK ink lines only, no colour, no gray, no tonal shading, no hatching, no dense tile grids, no filled shadows or dark windows: leave all surfaces and openings white. Front-facing upright elevation, almost orthographic. Square 1536x1536 composition, whole structure about 80% of height, centered, generous white margin around ridge ornaments and bottom of stairs. No text, no border, no caption, no watermark. The white will later become transparent and the ink will receive a muted silver-gray modern-era palette through the existing website pipeline.

site_recommendation.lede: 王之涣笔下的名楼，今天重新立在蒲州古城以西的黄河岸边。眼前的楼体于2002年重建落成：高台托起四重檐口，层层柱廊把登高望远的诗意接回现实。
facts: 现存楼体：1997年12月开工重建，2002年9月26日落成开放；本图与年表均按2002年登记。
仿唐楼阁：外观四檐三层，通高73.9米，坐南朝北，采用唐风彩画与舒展檐口。
古楼沿革：原楼始建于北周，历唐、宋，元初毁于战火；创建年代与现存重建建筑分别记录。

verification: 已逐图核对：四重屋檐、上下柱廊、高台中轴阶梯均完整，正面居中、无文字、黑线白底；按近现代灰银色接入。
